parameters.content:
## Employee Offboarding Automation Workflow

Starter template from agentmelt.com — configure before running:

1. Fill in "Config (edit me)" (name, approver, quiet hours; test_mode stays on for the first week).
2. Add credentials to every service node (Anthropic, mail, CRM, database…).
3. Replace placeholder URLs, queries and field mappings with yours.
4. Set the trigger: The HRIS fires when an employment end date is set. A daily Schedule Trigger also scans for end dates within 14 days as a safety net.
5. Keep the gates: 'Needs a person?' after every AI step, 'Approved?' after the approval — wire their dead ends to a sheet or a channel.
6. Keep the guardrails:
   - The workflow requests revocation; IT executes it. Nothing is deleted automatically.
   - Involuntary exits skip the welcome-style messaging and trigger same-day revocation tickets.
   - The knowledge-transfer draft never includes compensation or performance data.
   - Closure is verified, not assumed: open tickets escalate until an IT lead closes them.

Full blueprint and pricing: https://agentmelt.com/workflows/employee-offboarding-automation/
Want it built and run for you? $197/month · custom $2,000–3,500 one-time

Employee, role, last working day, reason category (voluntary/involuntary), manager and location. Involuntary departures take a fast path with same-day access revocation.

nodes.name: Config (edit me)
nodes.notes:
Fill these in once; every later node reads them as $('Config (edit me)').item.json.config.*

test_mode = true: log what the workflow would write, without writing it, for the first week.
approval_mode = true: the approval node waits for a person; switch off per message type once it has earned it.

Also point the nodes at your own sources:
- HRIS termination record
- Identity provider group membership (Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace)
- Onboarding tracking board (what was granted)
- IT ticketing system
- Asset register (sheet or ITAM tool)

options.systemMessage:
You are the "Generate the knowledge-transfer checklist" step of the Employee Offboarding Automation Workflow workflow run by Agentmelt.
Task: Drafts a handover document for the manager from the role description and recent project data (Jira, Notion, Drive): open items, recurring responsibilities, systems owned, people to introduce. The manager edits, not writes.

Rules:
- The workflow requests revocation; IT executes it. Nothing is deleted automatically.
- Involuntary exits skip the welcome-style messaging and trigger same-day revocation tickets.
- The knowledge-transfer draft never includes compensation or performance data.
- Closure is verified, not assumed: open tickets escalate until an IT lead closes them.
- Answer only from the data provided in the input. If something is missing, say so in the output instead of guessing.
- If this step produces a message or a document, put the full text in `draft` (and a `subject` if it is an email); put a one-line summary in `summary`.
- Set `needs_human` true whenever you are unsure, the input is unusual, or a rule above applies; a person will look at it.
- Return valid JSON matching the output schema; no prose outside the JSON.

nodes.name: Needs a person: Generate the knowledge-transfer checklist
